{{Short description|Iranian mathematician (1962–2019)}}
'''Farideh Firoozbakht''' ({{langx|fa|فریده فیروزبخت}}; 18 March 1962 – 24 December 2019) was an Iranian mathematician. She stated [[Firoozbakht's conjecture]] on the distribution of [[prime number]]s in 1982.<ref name="Ribenboim">{{cite book|last=Ribenboim|first=Paulo|title=The Little Book of Bigger Primes Second Edition |year=2004|url=https://archive.org/details/littlebookbigger00ribe_610|url-access=limited| publisher=Springer-Verlag| page=[https://archive.org/details/littlebookbigger00ribe_610/page/n209 185]}}</ref><ref name=ppagc30>{{cite web|last=Rivera|first=Carlos|title=Conjecture 30. The Firoozbakht Conjecture|url=https://www.primepuzzles.net/conjectures/conj_030.htm|accessdate=22 August 2012}}</ref> She studied [[pharmacology]] and later mathematics at the [[University of Isfahan]] and taught mathematics at Iranian universities including the University of Isfahan.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Puzzlers |url=https://www.primepuzzles.net/thepuzzlers/Firoozbakht.htm |accessdate=5 February 2020}}</ref>
